title: Standard refund policy
body: Fictional Northstar Cloud standard monthly subscriptions are refundable within 14 calendar days of the initial purchase. Renewals are not refundable. Enterprise contracts follow their signed terms. A support specialist must verify eligibility; this assistant cannot issue a refund.

title: Account recovery and identity verification
body: For a fictional Northstar Cloud account locked by failed sign-in attempts, wait 15 minutes and use the password reset link. Never share passwords, recovery codes or API keys with support. If a verified account owner cannot receive the reset email, escalate to the identity support team. Support must not bypass identity verification.

title: PAY-504 checkout timeout investigation
body: PAY-504 identifies a checkout gateway timeout in fictional Northstar Cloud. Inspect payment-api latency and its dependency billing-worker. Check the payment queue depth and recent deployment changes. The Payments team owns payment-api. Escalate persistent failures to Payments; do not retry payment capture automatically because duplicate charges are possible.

title: HTTP 429 model quota response
body: For fictional Northstar Cloud model gateway HTTP 429 errors, inspect Retry-After and the model quota. Apply bounded exponential backoff with jitter. If the primary endpoint remains unavailable before any response content is emitted, route to the permitted secondary model. Respect the overall deadline and team budget. After streaming starts, report a partial response error instead of merging another model answer.

title: Enterprise cancellation policy
body: Fictional Northstar Cloud enterprise subscriptions require 30 days written cancellation notice and are not covered by the standard 14-day refund policy. The signed enterprise contract determines refund eligibility. Escalate contractual exceptions to the enterprise support team; never promise a refund based on the monthly plan policy.

title: Delayed reset email
body: For delayed fictional Northstar Cloud password reset emails, check spam and junk folders, confirm the registered email address through the approved identity workflow, and wait 10 minutes before requesting another link. Links expire after 20 minutes. Escalate delivery failures to the Identity team without exposing account existence to an unverified requester.
